selection_basis: contiguous ground-truth trajectory segment with all 100 sampled positions within 20 m of the 552-frame training-map trajectory; no model predictions used
query_rule: For each integer UTC-second bin intersecting the locked interval, take the earliest Cam5 image in the interval; pair it with the nearest synchronized Velodyne scan if time separation is at most 100000 us. Use every paired bin without selecting on pose error.
input_spec: Original full LiDAR scan, 1-100 m range, polar voxel size 0.2 m, no point cap; same Cam5 undistortion, half resolution, calibration and valid-view mask as training
historical_record_search: No 2012-04-29 mention in RESEARCH_HANDOFF.md, research/*.md/json, or work/*.md/json at designation time
test_use: Run only after learning-rate selection and checkpoint choice have been frozen on validation. Do not tune from this interval's results.
failure_policy: If source archives, camera processing, timestamp pairing, calibration, or minimum pair count fail, mark confirmation unavailable without replacing the interval after seeing model results.
